label: Apple MacBook Pro 14-inch (M4) laptop
description: 14-inch M4 MacBook Pro. Wireless is Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) - Apple does not claim Wi-Fi 7 on this machine - and there is no Ethernet port: the chassis carries three Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) ports plus HDMI, an SDXC card slot and MagSafe 3. Radios: one wlan (Wi-Fi 6E); wired networking would have to come from a Thunderbolt or USB-C adapter, so no RJ45.
notes: Apple's spec sheet contains no Ethernet, Gigabit or RJ-45 entry at all - the absence is the fact worth recording, and the notes say so plainly. The M4 Pro/M4 Max versions of this chassis move to Thunderbolt 5, but the base M4 is Thunderbolt 4, so do not assume 5 here. Wi-Fi stays 6E: writing Wi-Fi 7 would be a guess Apple does not support.
